tools.name: rainbow_bridge_video_overview
tools.description: What a Rainbow Bridge memorial video is: the 5 scenes with sample videos, length, format, the optional end card (name, years, farewell line), music, delivery time and how it is delivered.

tools.name: rainbow_bridge_photo_tips
tools.description: Photo requirements (one pet, no people, file types, size) and tips for choosing the photo that gives the closest likeness.

tools.name: pet_memorial_ideas
tools.description: Gentle ideas from the site’s guides: ways to remember a pet, pet loss gifts for someone else, what to write in a sympathy card, or where to find free pet loss support. Links to the full page.
